title: Destination types: broadcast/team/direct
notes: Aligned Compact CoT destination types with spec/07 Section 10.1.1: stable wire tags broadcast=0x00, team=0x01, direct=0x02; team destinations accept only defined Team values 0x01-0x0A; direct destinations carry the required full 16-byte native IPv6 address (not an 8-byte IID). Python core/gateway constructors reject missing or extraneous destination fields. Python and Rust decoders reject invalid tags/teams, truncated IDs/messages, and trailing bytes. Canonical corpus now has 6 positive and 6 negative chat vectors, consumed byte-exactly by Python and Rust. Green: Python Compact CoT suites 162, focused ruff (gateway test with inherited E402 ignored only), mypy 2 modules, schema validation; Rust vector tests 3, focused module 20, rustfmt, no_std cargo check, clippy -D warnings. messaging.py untouched; no codereview/commit/push.
